class: an earlier run's report and logs overwritten by the next run into the same output folder
caught_by: before a kind runs, its previous report, when it parses with a generatedAt, moves with that kind's logs into history/<generatedAt>/ under the output folder, and the five newest such folders per kind are kept. The new report keeps its path, so the command string a ledger keys on never varies
missed_by: one report per output folder, replaced on every run, so an earlier QA pass's evidence survived only where a role had copied it by hand
